prisoners_dilemma._doc: PD payoffs to the row player as a function of (row_action, col_action): (D,C)=b, (C,C)=b-c, (D,D)=0, (C,D)=-c. Requires b > c > 0 (strict).

undefined_outcomes._doc: Default action pair for the (CupodBot, DupocBot) cell, which is unresolved in Critch et al. 2022. Format: '(row_action, col_action)' with row=CupodBot, col=DupocBot. The (MirrorBot, MirrorBot) non-terminating cell is handled by excluding MirrorBot from the analysis altogether.
